Visualize Audio Segments or Motifs

Source: R/motif.R
visualize_segments.Rd

A generic function to visualize spectrograms of extracted motif renditions across conditions or labels. For a lys object, displays a multi-panel grid comparing samples across labels side-by-side (e.g. PD vs. UD motifs).

Usage

visualize_segments(x, ...)

# Default S3 method
visualize_segments(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'lys'
visualize_segments(
  x,
  labels = NULL,
  n_samples = 4,
  by_column = TRUE,
  seed = NULL,
  fft_window_size = 1024,
  overlap = 0.75,
  dark_mode = TRUE,
  ...
)

Arguments

x

A lys object or a data frame containing segment information.

...

Additional arguments passed to specific methods.

labels

Optional character vector of labels to include (e.g. c("PD", "UD")). If NULL, all available labels are plotted.

n_samples

Integer. Number of motif renditions to plot per label. Default 4.

by_column

Logical. If TRUE (default), displays each label in its own column, with rows corresponding to individual motif renditions.

seed

Optional integer. Random seed for reproducible sampling.

fft_window_size

Integer. FFT window size for spectrograms. Default 1024.

overlap

Numeric. Overlap percentage for spectrograms. Default 0.75.

dark_mode

Logical. Whether to use dark theme for spectrograms. Default TRUE.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Inspect 4 PD and 4 UD motifs side-by-side
visualize_segments(lys, labels = c("PD", "UD"), n_samples = 4)
} # }
